player_prompt.intro:
I ka kɛlɛ Slitherlink kɔrɔ {R}x{C} kɛlɛbolo kan!
Kɛlɛ dɔ kan ka bɔnɛ kɔkan wɛrɛ kɔkan, kɔkan dɔ wɛrɛ bɛɛ kɛlɛbolo kan ka tɛmɛnɛ dɔ wɛrɛ.
Kɛlɛbolo kan ka tɛmɛnɛ dɔ wɛrɛ ma:
  [h r c] - kɛlɛbolo kan ka tɛmɛnɛ dɔ wɛrɛ kɔkan kɔnɔ dots kɔrɔ r, cɛmɛnɛ c
  [v r c] - kɛlɛbolo kan ka tɛmɛnɛ dɔ wɛrɛ kɔkan kɔnɔ dots kɔrɔ r, cɛmɛnɛ c
Nambari dɔ wɛrɛ kɔkan dɔ wɛrɛ kɛlɛbolo kan ka tɛmɛnɛ dɔ wɛrɛ, '.' kɔrɔ kɛlɛbolo kan ka tɛmɛnɛ dɔ wɛrɛ tɛ.
I ka kɛlɛ {max_turns} kɛlɛbolo kan ka tɛmɛnɛ dɔ wɛrɛ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sɛɛn donkili kɛɛnɛ. Sɔn [h row col] ani [v row col].
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Kɛlɛbolo kan ka tɛmɛnɛ dɔ wɛrɛ kɔkan kɔnɔ.

outcome.win: 🎉 I ka kɛlɛ kɔkan dɔ wɛrɛ kɛlɛbolo kan! Kɛlɛbolo kan ka tɛmɛnɛ dɔ wɛrɛ!
outcome.turn_limit: Dɔrɔ dɔrɔn dɔ sɔrɔ. Tɛmɛn dɔ tɛmɛnɛnɛ.
